description: Tetris 8 is a tribute to the classic with award-winning gameplay. This is "the must have puzzle game" of the marketplace. Survive as long as possible by sorting falling blocks in lines. The more lines you create, the more points you get! If the line reaches the top the game is over. Increasing the difficulty level provides entertainment for everyone. Compete with your friends in the online leaderboards, and get the highest score you can. Immerse yourself in a game of colored blocks and relax listening to groovy music! Test your wits and reflexes!
